summary: Phase 2 frontend regression + new sections tested end-to-end via Playwright. All 12 requested checks pass: SEO (title/meta/OG/JSON-LD), ScrollProgress (scaleX changes with scroll), header logo (3 colored bars + Complete Care + Pharmacy·Clinic·Physio tagline, click scrolls to top), hero picker for all 3 brands, brand cards render + expander/website, Pharmasave shows only 'Free Local Rx Delivery' (no 'Canada Post Inside'), all 3 addresses = 150-909 5 Avenue SW, Calgary AB, Location section (heading, iframe with maps.google.com src, Get Directions link), FAQ accordion (6 items, single-collapsible behavior verified), Message form (empty submit shows no success; valid submit shows send-another), Contact strip tel:/google.com/maps links for all 3 brands, mobile sticky bar (mobile-book, mobile-message, mobile-directions) visible and mobile-message opens sheet. No console errors, no page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html changes in /app/frontend/public are not picked up by the running CRA dev server via hot-reload — required a `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` for SEO/OG/JSON-LD to be served. Main agent should be aware: any future public/ changes need a frontend restart (or a build).

LocationMap uses keyless iframe embed (maps.google.com/maps?...&output=embed) — works today but is technically the deprecated embed. Consider switching to /maps/embed/v1/place with a Maps Embed API key for long-term stability.

ScrollProgress useScroll listens to window scroll but page uses Lenis smooth-scroll — currently OK because Lenis forwards to window.scrollY, but if Lenis is swapped to element-based scroll the progress bar will freeze.
BrandCard badges use CSS uppercase transform; if tests rely on inner_text they will get uppercased values (minor test-authoring gotcha, not a bug).
seed_data_creation: One additional TEST_Playwright message posted via message form during valid-submit test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 2 features verified on both desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). If you edit /app/frontend/public/index.html again, restart the frontend supervisor to see changes. Site uses Lenis smooth scroll — scroll with page.mouse.wheel or element.scroll_into_view_if_needed(). Shadcn Select: click trigger, then click [role='option'] with force=True.
rca of the issue: Initial run showed default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' title and no OG/JSON-LD. Root cause: CRA dev server had cached the old public/index.html; restarting the frontend via supervisor picked up the new SEO markup. Not a code bug — a dev-server hot-reload limitation.
